title: Production Outage Response
description: Critical production infrastructure outage affecting clinical operations
immediate_actions: Declare P1 incident and activate incident commander
Enable emergency failover systems if available
investigation_steps: Verify network connectivity to clinical facilities
Review recent system changes and deployments
Check with external service providers (connectivity, cloud providers)
resolution_steps: Restore primary systems from backup if necessary
Implement temporary workarounds for clinical staff
Coordinate with clinical teams for patient care continuity
verification: Confirm EHR system accessibility across all facilities
Test network connectivity to critical endpoints
Confirm with clinical staff that systems are operational
special_considerations: Security incidents involving patient data must be escalated immediately
Do not restart EHR production servers without customer IT approval
Patient care continuity is highest priority
HIPAA compliance must be maintained throughout incident
